clinics_document_uidx.name: clinics_document_uidx
clinics_document_uidx.where: "clinics"."document" IS NOT NULL AND "clinics"."deleted_at" IS NULL

clinics_member_access.name: clinics_member_access
clinics_member_access.using:
(
    "clinics"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.clinic_id', true), '')::uuid
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM clinic_memberships m
      WHERE m.clinic_id = "clinics"."id"
        AND m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
        AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND m.status IN ('active', 'suspended')
    )
  )

roles_clinic_key_uidx.name: roles_clinic_key_uidx
roles_clinic_key_uidx.where: "roles"."clinic_id" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."deleted_at" IS NULL

professionals_user_id_uidx.name: professionals_user_id_uidx
professionals_user_id_uidx.where: "professionals"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "professionals"."deleted_at" IS NULL

professionals_council_uidx.name: professionals_council_uidx
professionals_council_uidx.where:
"professionals"."council_type" IS NOT NULL
          AND "professionals"."council_number" IS NOT NULL
          AND "professionals"."deleted_at" IS NULL

patients_clinic_document_uidx.name: patients_clinic_document_uidx
patients_clinic_document_uidx.where: "patients"."document" IS NOT NULL AND "patients"."deleted_at" IS NULL
